arguments:
{"script":"mkdir -p ~/linux_problem
cat > ~/linux_problem/count_sample_dir.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Counts non-hidden files and directories inside ~/linux_problem/sample_dir (recursive), excluding hidden entries
DIR="${HOME}/linux_problem/sample_dir"
if [ ! -d "$DIR" ]; then
  echo "0"
  exit 0
fi
count=$(find "$DIR" -mindepth 1 \( -path '*/.*' -prune \) -o -type f -print -o -type d -print | wc -l)
printf "%d\n" "$count"
EOF
chmod +x ~/linux_problem/count_sample_dir.sh
printf "Created ~/linux_problem/count_sample_dir.sh\n""}
